page: Amazon Web Services m7i.24xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by the Nitro hypervisor. It features 96 vCPUs and 48 physical cores based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon 8488C processors running at 3.2 GHz. The instance is equipped with 384.0 GB of DDR5 memory operating at 5 GHz, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It lacks local storage and dedicated GPU hardware, but includes a baseline network bandwidth of 38 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates strong multi-core performance, with stress-ng multi-core and Geekbench multi-core scores placing in the top 25%. The Intel Xeon processor supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 and Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), which contribute to top-tier performance in Passmark CPU encryption and Geekbench image processing. Memory bandwidth benchmarks for both cached and uncached read/write operations consistently rank in the top 25%, though the Passmark memory score is in the middle 50%.

This instance is well-suited for enterprise-grade general-purpose workloads, software compilation, database operations, and medium-scale LLM inference, where its AMX instructions accelerate prompt processing. Given the high resource density of 96 dedicated vCPUs and DDR5 memory, it offers qualitative cost efficiency for highly parallelized workloads that do not require local NVMe storage or discrete GPU acceleration.
